title: Six pillars hand
subject: Islamic Studies
unit: Spring 1: The six pillars of iman
source: Written for islamic-studies/y2 lesson 1 (Pupil PDF worksheet: six pillars hand)
intro: Lesson 1: What is iman? Believing in Allah. Listen, look, then do the tasks with a grown-up.

panels.title: What is iman?
points: Iman is belief in our hearts
We show iman with good actions

box.title: Draw round your hand and add one more finger shape for the sixth. Write one pillar of iman on each: Allah, angels, books, messengers, the Last Day, qadar.

keywords.def: believing in our hearts and showing it in what we do
the One who made everything; we worship only Him
to know something is true in your heart
a strong post that holds something up

questions.q: Say the six pillars of iman on your fingers.
questions.a: Allah, angels, books, messengers, Last Day, qadar

questions.q: Who made the sun, the sea and you?
Draw three things Allah made. Write 'Allah made this' under each.
questions.a: For example: the sun, a tree, a cat, each labelled 'Allah made this'.

questions.q: Extend: how many pillars of iman are there?
Stretch: how can we know Allah is there if we cannot see Him?
questions.a: We see everything He made, like we know wind is there when trees move.

questions.q: Which is the FIRST pillar of iman?
questions.a: A) Belief in Allah. Belief in Allah comes first; all the others come from it.

questions.q: Think again: how do we know Allah is there?
questions.a: We see all that He has made.
